# Alembic Migrations Using Dynamic Database URL

This file provides functions to run database migrations in both offline and online modes without hardcoding the database URL. Instead, the URL is retrieved dynamically from knowledge_compiler.storage.db, ensuring environment-appropriate connections for migration operations.
